description: This file is a header (.h) file defining the interface for accessing device processor information in a TR-069 device management context. It includes class declarations, constants, and documentation related to device processor APIs.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface
classes.description: Provides an interface for retrieving device processor information, including methods for instance management and querying processor architecture.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_Processor_Architecture
methods.description: Retrieves the architecture information of the device processor.
